fieldValues.title: RFC-004 Change D: Add schema-member type
fieldValues.proposed_change: Add `com.semanticops.spec/schema-member` to represent one addressable member of a schema definition, including member name, type expression, requiredness, nullability, constraints, schema default value, examples, deprecation, semantic purpose, and notes.
fieldValues.rationale: Members need identity so invariants, examples, and migrations can cite individual schema properties.
